text: Three employers say candidates received the interview reminder twice. Ticket cluster TF-184.
First thought: queue visibility may be too short, so a worker could pick up the message while the first send is still running.
Check timings before changing it. TalentFlow is configured differently from the old platform onboarding page.
Visibility is 90s and the affected jobs finished within 12s. That theory does not fit.
Found a stronger lead: retryNotification calls the gateway again after 503 but does not forward notification.id as idempotencyKey.
That matches the duplicate provider submissions. Treat missing idempotency forwarding as the root cause; queue timeout is ruled out.
I'll tell support we have a contained notification issue, not duplicated interviews.
